description: This file defines a class LRUMap which extends LinkedHashMap to implement a Least Recently Used (LRU) cache. It manages a maximum size and automatically removes the eldest entries when the size exceeds this maximum, serving as a specialized Map implementation with caching behavior.

classes.name: LRUMap
classes.description: A LinkedHashMap subclass implementing an LRU cache with a maximum size, removing least recently used entries when capacity is exceeded.

methods.name: LRUMap()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the cache with a default size of 10.

methods.name: LRUMap(int size)
methods.description: Constructor allowing specification of maximum size.

methods.name: LRUMap(int size, int initialCapacity)
methods.description: Constructor allowing specification of maximum size and initial capacity.

methods.name: LRUMap(int size, int initialCapacity, float loadFactor)
methods.description: Constructor allowing full customization of load factor along with size and initial capacity.

methods.name: setMaxSize(int size)
methods.description: Method to update the maximum size of the cache after creation.

methods.name: removeEldestEntry(Map.Entry<K, V> entry)
methods.description: Overrides the method to remove the eldest entry when cache size exceeds maxSize.
